_doc: §164e (2026-09-25): rows after Mar-2016 whose only date is an ASSUMED quarter-end + 21 days (third-party value fills with no exchange timestamp) are served UN-DATED by build_engine_feed, like the pre-Jun-2016 convention rows (§105/§118). An evidenced date (shp_sub_dates.json / shp_lag_fix.json) always wins; remove a key here when one is found.

§164h (2026-09-26): 15 more keys — the §164e sweep tested the SERVED date for the exact quarter-end + 21 signature and missed rows whose assumed date shp_lag_fix had moved to the next trading day (BSE Ltd x9, CDSL x4, SUNDARMFIN, UBL). History slot 5 still holds the exact +21 date, so build_engine_feed's existing test un-dates them.

keys.BSE|20170331: served date 2017-04-21 is an ASSUMED quarter-end + 21 days (fill shp_fill_thirdparty.json.gz, tag 'trendlyne_rows+our_old_format_formula;prom=BSE shpSecSummery_New Table-I;subdate'); no exchange timestamp evidenced -> served undated (engine convention quarter-end + 28)
keys.KIOCL|20170331: served date 2017-04-21 is an ASSUMED quarter-end + 21 days (fill shp_fill_thirdparty.json.gz, tag 'kiocl own Reg-31 filing (XLS) via wayback of kioclltd.in cms/282; Table I prom 6'); no exchange timestamp evidenced -> served undated (engine convention quarter-end + 28)
keys.SUNDARMFIN|20180630: served date 20180723 is an ASSUMED quarter-end + 21 days (2018-07-21) moved to the next trading day by shp_lag_fix (20180721 -> 20180723: a weekend/holiday shift of the same assumption, not a measurement); no exchange timestamp evidenced -> served undated (engine convention quarter-end + 28). §164h 2026-09-26
keys.CDSL|20180331: served date 2018-04-21 is an ASSUMED quarter-end + 21 days (fill shp_fill_nse_gaps.json.gz, CDSL's own Mar-2018 shareholding PDF; no exchange timestamp evidenced - NSE's master no longer serves 2018) -> served undated (engine convention quarter-end + 28)
